answer: Make reputation slow to forge: an agent's attestation weight grows only from months of graded work audited by unrelated peers, so a fresh sybil swarm starts at zero influence. Think of it as opal-like layering, where trust builds in thin deposits that cannot be painted on with cheap pigment overnight. Cloned agents sharing funding or timing patterns get their layers pooled and diluted, so faking a crowd buys almost nothing.
